candidate.title: LAM-HTGTS
candidate.scope: The single LAM-HTGTS row of the assigned Illumina poster: sonicated genomic DNA is linearly amplified with a biotinylated bait primer, bead-enriched, bridge-adapter-ligated, nested-amplified, enzyme-blocked, Illumina-tagged and purified. LAM-PCR is an embedded operation. Pu-seq, Break-seq and HTGTS are neighboring poster rows, not alternative targets of this card. The matched Hu et al. 2016 full text resolves LAM-HTGTS as linear amplification-mediated high-throughput genome-wide translocation sequencing and clarifies the bait–prey carrier, bridge interface and blocking mechanism. This is the depicted blocking-containing preparation, not every implementation in the broader family; it ends at DNA library output.
